title.narrative: Provision of life-saving health services to crisis-affected populations in Beletweyne district, Hiraan region, Somalia.

description.narrative: ltpgtThis 12-month health project is designed to improve the health outcomes of vulnerable populations in Beletweyne district, Somalia, through two (2) fixed Health Centers (ltbgtLafoole HClt/bgt and ltbgtDonsubagle HClt/bgt), two (2) Primary Health Units (ltbgtShabelle PHU lt/bgtand ltbgtEx-airport PHUlt/bgt), and two (2) Mobile Outreach Teams (10 outreach sites: ltbgtGasle, Qooqane, Lebow, Guriyacade, Burqaninyo,Bawaqo, Darusalam, Hoodley, Shirkanico, Shabellowlt/bgt). Out of the estimated population of 131,260, targeting ltbgt36,369lt/bgt ltbgtindividualslt/bgt, including 12,729 women, 9,274 girls, 5,456 men, 8,910 boys, and 5,455 persons with disabilities, the intervention prioritizes crisis-affected communities, especially IDPs and hard-to-reach areas. ltbrgtThe project aligns with the Somalia NTP (2025–2029), National Development Plan (2020–2024), the Health Cluster Strategic Response Plan, and the Somalia Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan (HNRP 2025). It supports the delivery of the ltbgtEssential Package of Health Services (EPHS) lt/bgtpillars, including primary care maternal, newborn, and child health (MNCH) emergency obstetric care immunization disease surveillance gender-based violence (GBV) case management and sexual and reproductive health (SRH) services. Activities include outpatient and inpatient consultations, trauma and ambulance services, routine vaccinations, ANC and PNC, delivery services, post-rape care, psychosocial support, and family planning.ltbrgtTwelve (12) trained ltbgtCommunity Health Workerslt/bgt (CHWs), one per PHU and one per outreach site, will provide basic health services, including case detection, referrals, and follow-ups. They will also lead social mobilization campaigns and health promotion activities focused on hygiene, disease prevention, and encouraging early health-seeking behaviors. Community engagement will be prioritized to reach the most marginalized, including female-headed households and persons with disabilities, using tailored communication methods and accessible services.ltbrgtHealth system capacity will be strengthened throughltbgt medical supplies, staff training, and enhanced referral linkageslt/bgt. The Ministry of Health will play a supervisory role to ensure sustainability, local ownership, and alignment with national standards. The project includes robust infection prevention and control (IPC), mental health, and nutrition screening components.ltbrgtBy bridging access gaps and responding to critical service disruptions following USAID cuts and La Niña-related shocks, this project aims to reduce preventable mortality and support the resilience of the local health system. Accountability and protection are mainstreamed across all activities, with mechanisms for confidential feedback and inclusive targeting. Through this approach, Mercy-USA will deliver immediate, lifesaving health care while laying the groundwork for longer-term recovery and strengthening local health systems.ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgt
